name: Four-leaf milkweed
desc: Four-leaf milkweed (Asclepias quadrifolia): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 11 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Asclepias quadrifolia, commonly called four-leaved milkweed or fourleaf milkweed, is a species of milkweed in the Apocynaceae (dogbane) family.
